posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
God, this cover is great.

A movie about me? Awesome.

Oh man, a story leading up to hero vs. hero combat? I’m here for this!

Wait, that’s Jefferson Knight and not Captain Cosmic? :OOOO Shit, this is cool.

This episode is giving me a real sense of what it would have been like to be a comics reader in the 90’s in this universe, as they note all the various characters and what they’re doing at the time.

Also, I’m really liking this creative process, because we know who’s on the final roster, so it’s like, “Okay, how does Christopher get convinced to go with Sky-Scraper?”

Glamour feels like a natural fit. I’m finding I actually really like her, considering she doesn’t have an EE deck (and I absolutely hate the one card she is on).

Oh man, Skeleton Key time? We need more of these obscure minor villains in roles like this! And he dies and gets brought back to life by Zhu Long? Does he become someone else at that point?

And I’m chuffed that we’ve gotten another episode that fulfills my desire for more bad stories. :3

I recently learned of the Olympic winter sport called Skeleton, and now I regret that Skeleton Key is just bones.

“We never have duos…” except Natch/Thriya and Guischolare.

I love Christopher slooooowly cracking up over the dirty joke.

“What does he look like?” Heee…lookalikeaman! (Who suspiciously resembles Bishop.)

Some quality outro mouth music on that one. That feels weird for me to say.
